newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal recoups 453 bln esc tax, soc sec arrears.
newsitem.headline: Portugal recoups 453 bln esc tax, soc sec arrears.

text.p: The Portuguese government has recouped 453 billion escudos in tax and social security arrears under the so-called Mateus Plan, according to Finance Ministry figures.
The figures include 328 billion escudos from tax arrears and 125 billion from social security arrears.

The Mateus Plan, named after its architect, Economy Minister Augusto Mateus, aims to obtain payment of arrears and to help ailing companies to recover financially by encouraging bank financing backed by state guarantees.
The deadline for the submission of applications to repay arrears was January 31.
